ddl.value: "label" is null or char_length("label") between 1 and 100
ddl.name: focus_sessions_label_length

ddl.value:
("progress_mode" = 'slider' and "target_count" is null and "current_count" is null)
        or ("progress_mode" = 'count'
          and "target_count" between 1 and 1000000
          and "current_count" between 0 and 1000000)
ddl.name: goals_progress_shape

ddl.value:
("schedule_kind" = 'flexible' and "weekdays" is null and "month_days" is null)
        or ("schedule_kind" = 'specific_days' and "period_unit" = 'day' and "period_length" = 1
          and (("weekdays" is null) <> ("month_days" is null))
          and ("weekdays" is null or (cardinality("weekdays") > 0 and "weekdays" <@ '{0,1,2,3,4,5,6}'::smallint[]))
          and ("month_days" is null or (cardinality("month_days") > 0 and 0 < all("month_days") and 32 > all("month_days"))))
ddl.name: habits_schedule_shape

ddl.value: ("status" = 'answered') = ("answer" is not null) and ("answer" is null or char_length("answer") between 1 and 1000)
ddl.name: relays_answer

ddl.value: "status" not in ('delivered', 'answered', 'declined') or "delivered_at" is not null
ddl.name: relays_delivered_at

ddl.value: "assigned_date" is null or "deadline_date" is null or "assigned_date" <= "deadline_date"
ddl.name: tasks_dates_order
